up: Retrieve the first 1000 rows of IC50 activity records (with pChEMBL values) for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2163176 (Lysine-specific demethylase 5C). Return the assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), the target type (target_dictionary.target_type), the tax_id of the target (target_dictionary.tax_id), the canonical SMILES of the molecule (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the molecule ChEMBL ID (compound_dictionary.chembl_id), the standard type (activities.standard_type), and the pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Ensure that only rows where activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.pchembl_value is NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '=' are included. Join activities to assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, target_dictionary to compound_dictionary on activities.molecule_chembl_id = compound_dictionary.chembl_id, and to compound_structures on activities.molecule_chembl_id = compound_structures.molecule_chembl_id. Order the final result set by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending) then assay ChEMBL ID (ascending).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cd.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary cd ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cd.chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE

  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND td.pref_name = 'Lysine-specific demethylase 5C'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163176'

up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows (with non‑null pChEMBL values) for the human single‑protein target with CHEMBL identifier CHEMBL2163176 (Lysine‑specific demethylase 5C). Return assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (compound_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Ensure only rows where activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL are included. Join activities to assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, and filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163176'. Join target_dictionary to molecule_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = target_dictionary.tid (to get molecule_chembl_id) and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Order the final result set by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending) then assay ChEMBL ID (ascending).
sql:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT tid, pref_name, tax_id, molregno
  FROM target_dictionary
  WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163176'
),
acts AS (
  SELECT a.assay_id, a.molregno, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation
  FROM activities a
  WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
),
assays_selected AS (
  SELECT a.assay_id, a.molregno, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.assay_id AS assay_chembl_id, t.molregno AS target_molregno
  FROM acts a
  JOIN target AS t ON a.molregno = t.molregno
)
SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       cd.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       acts.standard_type,
       acts.pchembl_value
FROM assays_selected ass
JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.assay_id = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary cd ON ass.molregno = cd.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON ass.molregno = cs.molregno
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000
